verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Change detection, dependency-graph planning, elastic scheduling, cache-key composition, lookup/hit/miss behavior, and failure handling are all represented with explicit components, labels, and directed paths.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The immutable artifact store is present, but the board does not show successful task execution uploading outputs into it; the untrusted-fork qualifier and rejection path at the protected-build trust gate are also only partially represented.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 40 of 42. All system-defining requirements have at least recognizable representation, with full coverage across planning, scheduling, key construction, cache lookup, failure semantics, and atomic same-key convergence. Two system-defining requirements are partial: the upload relationship into the immutable artifact store and the explicit exclusion of untrusted-fork results from protected builds. No cap applies.
